Experience vibrant, dynamic sound at any volume with the № 5302. Flexible, elegant and powerful, this high-quality amplifier delivers impeccable audio — and plenty of power — to drive high-end loudspeakers. Share the full potential of your music as every intricate detail takes shape around you.

Features
Flawless Amplification

Surround yourself with rich waves of sound that fill the entire room. The № 5302 contains a robust power supply that delivers just the right amount of power at just the right moment — so you can experience explosive dynamics and subtle details without distortion.

Flexible Performance

A bridgebale dual-monaural amplifier, the № 5302 can effortlessly power two loudspeakers or be configured to power just one. This gives you the option of adding a second amplifier for twice the power, so you have the ultimate control over your high-end audio system and listening experience.

Iconic Design

With bold geometry and luxurious finishes, the № 5302 is as elegant as it is powerful. The solid aluminum panels flow seamlessly into a sleek glass display. A large standby button is bordered by an understated ring light that indicates the power state. Together, these beautiful details come together to create a stunning, high-quality amplifier that completes your audio system.
